title: 油价高企压制：亚洲高收益？，长期价值显现
speaker: Jason Payne

segments.en: I think in terms of the Asia high older space, so this goes to more Indonesia, Philippines, India, I think they're still struggling a bit given the extended higher oil price, and you see that reflected fiscal deficits, you see that reflected in current account, and so on and so forth.
segments.zh: 在亚洲高收益领域，比如印尼、菲律宾、印度，由于油价持续高企，它们仍面临压力，这反映在财政赤字和经常账户等方面。

segments.en: So I think the value is there, but I think that's more of like a next year setup in terms of investments. So since about the value, we really like to carry, we need oil to normalize and perhaps turn premium to sort of normalize as well, but those are sort of your deep value like your type of assets, which can be very attractive over the longer term.
segments.zh: 所以价值是存在的，但更像是明年的布局。我们喜欢持有，需要油价正常化，期限溢价也正常化，但这些是深度价值资产，长期来看非常有吸引力。
